assets.alt: Neighbours share a sunny bay-side community hall and garden beneath eucalyptus trees.
assets.caption: Concept illustration: readiness grows through everyday relationships, useful shared places and local stewardship.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape editorial concept illustration for the opening page of an Australian community disaster resilience website, 1536 by 1024 pixels, 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: an optimistic bay island community hub where practical readiness is part of enjoyable everyday life.

Composition: a generous wide establishing view with foreground garden, central open verandah and bay beyond; the complete scene is composed inside the frame and ready to display uncropped.
Lighting and mood: clear warm morning light, respectful, hopeful and grounded.
Constraints: an imagined proposed concept, not documentary evidence of an existing installation. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. No floating arbitrary geometry, no science fantasy holograms or domes, no emergency rescue, no disaster damage, no staged hero poses.
